expertise.title: Expertise shaped by the market
paragraphs: The true value of knowledge is determined by its ability to remain relevant in a constantly changing world.
For more than 20 years, Serhii Ostapchuk has traded and worked in financial markets, going through various economic cycles, crises and periods of growth.
This experience became the foundation of the Academy and made it possible to create a training system based on understanding market processes, risk management and making informed decisions.

founder.role: Trader, investor and entrepreneur with more than 20 years of trading and financial-market experience.
paragraphs: Over the years of practice, an own approach to market analysis and capital management was formed, based on a combination of fundamental analysis, technical analysis and the psychology of decision-making.

The result of this work was the Capital Intelligence Academy — an educational ecosystem that combined many years of practical experience, modern development programs and an international community of people interested in financial growth and independence.

items.question: Is the training suitable for beginners?
items.answer: Yes. The programs are structured to consistently take the participant from a basic understanding of the financial markets to independent decision-making.

items.question: Is it possible to study if you already have experience in financial markets?
items.answer: Yes. After the consultation, the team will determine your current level and offer a route without repeating the topics already learned.

items.question: What is the difference between the Academy and other educational projects?
items.answer: The programs are based on practical experience, author's methodology, individual support and systematic work with risks.

items.question: Will I be able to make my own decisions after completing the program?
items.answer: Independence is one of the main goals of education. Participants learn to analyze the situation, form scenarios and argue for each decision.

items.question: Is it necessary to have a lot of capital to start studying?
items.answer: No. Training focuses on knowledge, discipline and risk management. The amount of practical capital is determined individually.

items.question: How long does training take?
items.answer: The duration depends on the chosen direction and individual pace. An exact plan is formed after the initial consultation.

items.question: What is included in mentoring?
items.answer: Verification of practical tasks, analysis of errors, answers to questions, analysis of market situations and recommendations for further development.

items.question: Is there a practical part of the training?
items.answer: Yes. Practice is integrated into all programs and progresses gradually, from training exercises to working with real market scenarios.

items.question: What is Market Intelligence?
items.answer: This is the direction of expert analytics: reviews of markets, key events, risks and possible scenarios for making informed decisions.

items.question: What is the difference between Trading Education and Investment Education?
items.answer: Trading Education focuses on working with short- and medium-term market scenarios, Investment Education on long-term capital management.

items.question: Does the Academy provide guarantees of profitability?
items.answer: Financial markets do not allow guarantees of results. The Academy provides a system of knowledge, practice and risk control tools.

items.question: What result can be considered successful after completing the program?
items.answer: Ability to independently analyze the market, make reasoned decisions, control risks and adhere to one's own system.

items.question: Is it possible to combine studies with work or business?
items.answer: Yes. The format is designed for busy people: the materials are available online, and the practical schedule is agreed with the mentor.

items.question: Do I still have access to the community after I finish the program?
items.answer: Yes, depending on the selected program, participants retain access to materials, analytics and professional community.
